_about: Pool (8-ball) in the club's games room (polish1 item 71: core/pool_sim.gd, core/pool_rules.gd, game/pool_game.gd). table = a 9 ft table in metres (cushion noses), ball radius, how far the cushions stop short of the pockets and how close a ball's centre must come to a pocket's middle to drop. physics: cue ball speed at full power, sliding / rolling slow-down (m/s2), english loss per second, restitutions, how much side english bends a cushion bounce. ai = the house players: aim error in degrees (normal), power error share, think seconds. shot_clock = seconds per shot (running out = a foul). stakes = chips (a win pays the stake again). tables = where the tables stand in the games room (centre from the club centre, yaw).
